effects: The vault takes `amount` of sUSDe (the collateral, 0x9D39…3497, set at init) from the signer with transferFrom, using the signer's allowance to the vault.
Vault active shares, priced at the current share rate, are credited to `onBehalfOf`. That address may not be the signer.
It reverts if a deposit whitelist is on and the signer is not whitelisted, or if the deposit limit would be exceeded.
formats.shown: Deposit into vault: the sUSDe amount from the signer, the vault, and the beneficiary who gets the position.

findings.title: deposit: the number of vault shares minted to the beneficiary is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_). The rate comes from storage. The descriptor shows only #.amount as sUSDe.
findings.fix: None possible. Shares depend on the vault's state at execution.

effects: The signer's active shares worth `amount` sUSDe, rounded up, are burned (_activeSharesOf[msg.sender] goes down).
`amount` sUSDe is queued in the next epoch's withdrawals. The withdrawal shares for that epoch go to `claimer`, who alone can claim them later. That address may not be the signer.
No tokens move now. The queued amount stays slashable until the epoch ends (7-day epochs) and must be claimed with claim/claimBatch.
formats.shown: Request withdrawal: the sUSDe amount, the vault, and the claim owner who will be able to claim it.

findings.title: withdraw: the screen does not say funds arrive only after the epoch ends and stay slashable until then.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; withdrawals[epoch] += withdrawnAssets. onSlash can reduce withdrawals[currentEpoch_+1]. Intent: "Request withdrawal".
findings.fix: Optionally change the intent to "Queue withdrawal (claimable after epoch ends)".

findings.title: withdraw: the number of the signer's shares burned is not shown, because it comes from the vault's state.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake()).

effects: `shares` of the signer's active vault shares are burned.
Their sUSDe value at the current rate is queued in the next epoch's withdrawals. The claim right goes to `claimer`, who may not be the signer.
No tokens move now. The amount is claimable after the epoch ends and is slashable until then.
formats.shown: Queue share withdrawal: the share count as a raw 18-decimal integer, and the claim owner.

findings.title: redeem: the shares are shown as a raw integer (987654321123456789), which a person cannot read.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field #.shares format "raw". Case 2 screen: "Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares". ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use format "unit" with params {"base":" shares","decimals":18} so it renders as 0.9877 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the sUSDe value queued for the shares is not shown, because it comes from the vault's state.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares()).

effects: The signer's whole withdrawal entitlement for `epoch` is marked claimed (isWithdrawalsClaimed[epoch][msg.sender] = true).
That amount of sUSDe is sent from the vault to `recipient`, who may not be the signer.
formats.shown: Claim withdrawal: the epoch number and the recipient. Neither the asset nor the amount is named.

findings.title: claim: the token paid out (sUSDe) is not named anywhere on the screen.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount). Collateral is sUSDe. Intent "Claim withdrawal" and interpolatedIntent "Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}" do not name the asset.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Claim sUSDe withdrawal" and the interpolatedIntent to "Claim sUSDe from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}".

findings.title: claim: the amount sent is not shown, because it comes from the vault's state.

effects: The signer's withdrawal entitlement for every listed epoch is marked claimed.
The sum of those amounts in sUSDe is sent from the vault to `recipient`, who may not be the signer.
formats.shown: Claim withdrawals: every epoch listed and the recipient. Neither the asset nor the total amount is named.

findings.title: claimBatch: the token paid out (sUSDe) is not named anywhere on the screen.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount). Intent "Claim withdrawals" and interpolatedIntent "Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}" do not name sUSDe.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Claim sUSDe withdrawals" and the interpolatedIntent to "Claim sUSDe from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".

findings.title: claimBatch: the total amount sent is not shown, because it comes from the vault's state.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: amount += _claim(epochs[i]), and _claim reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender).
